text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-98765 triggered -> node/gpu-node-42 kubelet NotReady. Severity: P1. Links: https://pagerduty.example/PD-98765

jess: Acked. I'm on it.

sanjay: Taking primary. Any customer-facing impact reported?

maria-sre: Logs show kubelet flapping, kube-proxy also showing 503s for pods on that node. Edge LB health checks failing for ~2m. Could be kernel panic or driver hang.

jess: Checking node console now. If it's a GPU host kernel panic we've seen the same pattern after recent nvidia-driver 550 rollouts.

sanjay: SSH to node fails: connection timed out. Trying serial console via provider.

kevin-platform: Noted. I'm pausing scheduling to that rack to avoid evict storms.

sanjay: Serial console output attached (snip):
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID 12345 ...
[ 1234.567995] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
Call Trace:
  <task> ...
```

sanjay: Looks like a kernel oops followed by panic. Host unreachable after panic.

jess: Confirming impact: metrics show steady increase in queue latency for hosted API route /v1/generate - about 8% of requests hitting fallbacks. Dedicated customers on that rack lost 2% capacity.

maria-sre: Customer impact: potential degraded throughput for AcmeCorp (dedicated: pool-34) and internal eval pipeline jobs failing. Opened incident severity notes.

jess: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Remove node from k8s cluster to avoid rescheduling; 2) Drain if possible, else mark unschedulable and shift traffic; 3) Reimage host or reprovision; 4) Notify customers if >5% capacity loss persists.

sanjay: Attempting cordon/evict: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-42` returns node not reachable. Forcing endpoint removal from LB: `kubectl patch endpoints ...` in progress.

kevin-platform: I've asked infra to reprovision replacement GPU host. ETA ~12m. I'll also disable driver auto-updates for that image until we confirm root cause.

jess: PagerDuty note: escalating to infra oncall (@kevin-platform) and kernel team (@maria-sre).

pagerduty: PD-98765 has been escalated to escalation policy: infra-kernel. 1 user notified.

maria-sre: Quick check — are there multiple nodes showing same Xid? Searching logs across cluster.

sanjay: Negative, only gpu-node-42 shows the panic pattern. Others show transient GPU driver warnings but stayed healthy.

jess: Customer comms draft: "We're investigating a GPU host failure that is currently impacting a small subset of Dedicated capacity. We're routing around the host and provisioning a replacement; we'll update in 30 minutes or when we have more details." Approve?

maria-sre: Approve. Add note: "no user data affected; inference traffic rerouted."

jess: Sent outbound to accounts: AcmeCorp + infra contacts.

kevin-platform: Replacement host provisioning complete. New host ip 10.5.22.88. Kube join in progress.

sanjay: New node joined and Ready. Rebalancing pods to new host.

jess: Traffic normalized. Metrics back to baseline for /v1/generate. No further fallbacks after rebalancing.

maria-sre: Root cause hypothesis: driver-induced kernel panic on gpu-node-42. We'll hold driver update in that image and run additional soak on canaries. Creating follow-up ticket INFRA-2217.

kevin-platform: Agreed. Reimaging gpu-node-42 for forensic capture; then decommission until we validate driver build.

jess: Oncall handoff: I'm handing off monitoring/checks to night oncall @sanjay for 30m watches and to verify no recurrence. I'll update the incident doc with timelines and attach console logs.

sanjay: Taking handoff. Will watch for 45m. If reoccurs, re-open PD.

incident-bot: Incident PD-98765 marked Resolved by jess. Resolution summary: node gpu-node-42 kernel panic -> host replaced; traffic rerouted; customers notified; follow-up ticket INFRA-2217 opened for driver rollback and validation.

jess: Thanks all. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
